name: Maple syrupUSDC / syrupUSDT
issuer: Maple Finance (Maple International Operations SPC, segregated portfolios)
underlying: Fixed-rate, overcollateralized loans to institutional crypto borrowers (trading firms, market makers) secured by digital-asset collateral (BTC, ETH, SOL etc.) held by custodians — a permissionless wrapper on Maple's institutional lending book, risk-segregated from Maple's KYC-gated institutional pools.

terms.jurisdiction: Cayman SPC issuer; US persons and sanctioned jurisdictions excluded from the official interface via geofencing (token itself is permissionless ERC-20)
terms.redemption: Open-ended; normally instant via pool liquidity, up to ~24h in rare cases, contractual max 30 days; also sellable on DEXs (Uniswap, Curve etc.)
terms.fees: No deposit/withdrawal fees to lenders; Maple takes protocol/performance fees out of gross loan interest (net APY displayed)

how_to_invest.method: Deposit USDC/USDT at Maple app (permissionless, wallet only)

risk_notes: Credit risk of institutional crypto borrowers, mitigated by overcollateralization with volatile digital assets and active margin calls — losses possible in fast crashes or custodial failure. Liquidity can gate to a 30-day max in stress; not available to US persons via the official interface. Distinct from Maple's KYC institutional products (min $100k+, full KYC); protocol-wide TVL ~$3.0B, syrupUSDC alone ~$0.97B.

name: Centrifuge / Janus Henderson Anemoy Treasury Fund (JTRSY) + deRWA
issuer: Anemoy Limited (BVI), sub-managed by Janus Henderson; tokenized on Centrifuge
underlying: A BVI-licensed professional fund holding short-term US Treasury bills — the US government is the borrower; NOT private credit. Centrifuge's flagship pool alongside JAAA (Janus Henderson AAA CLO fund, which is securitized corporate credit).

terms.min_investment: 500,000 USDC primary subscription; no minimum on secondary/deRWA
terms.jurisdiction: British Virgin Islands fund; non-US professional/accredited investors only for primary subscriptions
terms.redemption: Open-ended; onchain subscription/redemption 24/7/365, executed against NAV on the next US banking day; deRWA (deJTRSY) tokens are freely transferable and tradable on DEXs for instant exit
terms.fees: 0.25% management fee; 0% subscription and redemption fees

how_to_invest.method: KYC + subscribe on Centrifuge app (non-US professional investors)
Buy deJTRSY on supported DEXs (transfer-compliant wrapper)

risk_notes: Effectively US sovereign duration risk (very short T-bills) plus smart-contract, NAV-oracle, and BVI fund-structure risk — minimal credit risk character. Primary access gated to non-US professional investors; retail can only touch it via deRWA secondary liquidity. Centrifuge platform TVL ~$1.64B across all pools; JTRSY alone ~$881M.

name: Goldfinch Prime (WINDING DOWN)
underlying: One onchain pool giving exposure to senior secured loans from large institutional private-credit funds (Ares, Apollo, Golub and others) lending to mid-market corporate borrowers.

terms.jurisdiction: Was non-US persons only (US accredited retail was served via Heron Finance, $10k min)
terms.redemption: All existing Prime investors are being fully redeemed in the wind-down
terms.fees: Targeted 9-12% net of all fees when live

risk_notes: NOT INVESTABLE: GIP-87 (June 2026) wound down Goldfinch Prime and put the protocol in maintenance mode after legacy borrower-pool defaults (~$50M+). Kept in registry as a cautionary data point; exclude from the investable overview or show as historical.

name: Apollo Diversified Credit Securitize Fund (ACRED)
issuer: Securitize Tokenized Apollo Diversified Credit Fund (BVI feeder); managed by Securitize Capital, sub-advised by Apollo Global Management
underlying: Tokenized BVI feeder investing substantially all assets in the Apollo Diversified Credit Fund, a multi-strategy credit interval fund (corporate direct lending, asset-backed lending, performing credit, dislocated and structured credit).

terms.jurisdiction: BVI feeder under US Reg D exemption; offered via Securitize Markets (SEC-registered broker-dealer) to verified accredited investors
terms.redemption: Quarterly liquidity via the underlying interval fund's repurchase offers (typically 5-25% of shares per quarter, not guaranteed); no open-ended daily redemption
terms.lockup: No hard lockup, but practically illiquid between quarterly windows; sACRED vault (Polygon-Morpho) enables DeFi leverage, not exit
terms.fees: 0.50% tokenized-feeder management fee, 0% sub/redemption fees, plus the underlying Apollo fund's own fees and expenses

how_to_invest.method: KYC + accreditation verification and subscription via Securitize Markets

risk_notes: Real diversified private-credit risk: sub-investment-grade corporate and asset-backed exposure with NAV drawdown possible; liquidity limited to quarterly interval-fund repurchases that can be prorated in stress. On-chain AUM ~$95.6M as of Aug 31 2026 (the old ~$29M figure is stale); NAV-per-token ~$1,112, income accretes into NAV. 30D APY ~8.5% but variable.

name: Figure Markets Democratized Prime
underlying: A rate-matched onchain lending marketplace on Provenance where depositors lend USD/stablecoins/crypto to pools 100% collateralized by real loans originated by Figure and partners — HELOCs (home equity), auto loans, small-business loans — plus crypto-backed loans.

terms.min_investment: No stated minimum (deposit any amount from a Figure Markets account)
terms.jurisdiction: US-based platform (Figure Markets exchange account with standard KYC); availability subject to state/country restrictions — verify per-pool eligibility at signup
terms.redemption: Open-ended, no epochs: interest accrues hourly, add/withdraw anytime, marketed withdrawal within ~1 hour (subject to pool liquidity)
terms.fees: No explicit lender fee disclosed; Figure earns via origination/borrow-lend spread; rates float with pool supply/demand (advertised 8.5-12% 'up to', varies by pool)

how_to_invest.method: Create Figure Markets account (KYC), go to Earn > Democratized Prime, pick a pool and deposit

risk_notes: Consumer/SMB credit risk (HELOC, auto, SMB collateral) plus crypto-collateral volatility on crypto-backed pools; loans stated 100% collateralized on-chain but yields are variable and withdrawal speed depends on pool liquidity. Centralized-platform counterparty risk (not FDIC/SIPC insured). One of the few US-retail-accessible private-credit options.

name: Aave Horizon RWA Market
issuer: Aave Labs (Horizon), on the Aave v3 codebase
underlying: An Ethereum lending market where allowlisted institutions post permissioned tokenized RWAs (Superstate USTB/USCC, Centrifuge JTRSY/JAAA, Circle USYC etc. — mostly tokenized treasuries and AAA CLOs) as collateral to borrow stablecoins; suppliers lend USDC/RLUSD/GHO against that overcollateralized book.

terms.jurisdiction: Stablecoin supply side: permissionless/global (standard Aave interface geo-policies apply); RWA collateral side: only users qualified and allowlisted by each RWA issuer (institutional_only)
terms.redemption: Open-ended Aave-style: withdraw supplied stablecoins anytime subject to pool utilization (funds locked only when fully borrowed)
terms.fees: Standard Aave mechanics — suppliers earn borrow interest minus reserve factor; no deposit/withdrawal fees. Supply APY is variable/utilization-driven

how_to_invest.method: Supply USDC/RLUSD/GHO permissionlessly via the Horizon market in the Aave app

risk_notes: For stablecoin suppliers the credit character is indirect and comparatively strong: loans overcollateralized by tokenized treasuries/AAA CLOs from institutional borrowers, with liquidation machinery — key risks are RWA liquidation/settlement latency, oracle/NAV risk, and smart-contract risk rather than direct borrower default. Utilization risk can delay withdrawals.
